        "contents": "import { db } from '../firebase';\nimport { \n  collection, \n  doc, \n  getDoc, \n  updateDoc, \n  arrayUnion, \n  arrayRemove, \n  query, \n  where, \n  getDocs,\n  serverTimestamp,\n  Timestamp \n} from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { Project, ProjectCrewMember, ProjectInvitation } from '../models/Project';\n\nexport class ProjectCrewService {\n  private static readonly PROJECTS_COLLECTION = 'Projects';\n\n  /**\n   * Add a crew member to a project\n   */\n  static async addCrewMember(\n    projectId: string, \n    crewMember: Omit\u003cProjectCrewMember, 'joinedAt'\u003e\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] Adding crew member to project:', projectId);\n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] Crew member data:', crewMember);\n      \n      const projectRef = doc(db, this.PROJECTS_COLLECTION, projectId);\n      const projectDoc = await getDoc(projectRef);\n      \n      if (!projectDoc.exists()) {\n        console.error('[ProjectCrewService] Project not found:', projectId);\n        throw new Error('Project not found');\n      }\n\n      const projectData = projectDoc.data() as Project;\n      const existingCrew = projectData.crewMembers || [];\n      \n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] Existing crew members:', existingCrew.length);\n      \n      // Check if user is already a crew member\n      const isAlreadyCrewMember = existingCrew.some(\n        member =\u003e member.userId === crewMember.userId\n      );\n      \n      if (isAlreadyCrewMember) {\n        console.error('[ProjectCrewService] User is already a crew member:', crewMember.userId);\n        throw new Error('User is already a crew member of this project');\n      }\n\n      const newCrewMember: ProjectCrewMember = {\n        ...crewMember,\n        joinedAt: Timestamp.now()\n      };\n\n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] New crew member to add:', newCrewMember);",

        "originalContents": "import { db } from '../firebase';\nimport { \n  collection, \n  doc, \n  getDoc, \n  updateDoc, \n  arrayUnion, \n  arrayRemove, \n  query, \n  where, \n  getDocs,\n  serverTimestamp,\n  Timestamp \n} from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { Project, ProjectCrewMember, ProjectInvitation } from '../models/Project';\n\nexport class ProjectCrewService {\n  private static readonly PROJECTS_COLLECTION = 'Projects';\n\n  /**\n   * Add a crew member to a project\n   */\n  static async addCrewMember(\n    projectId: string, \n    crewMember: Omit\u003cProjectCrewMember, 'joinedAt'\u003e\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] Adding crew member to project:', projectId);\n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] Crew member data:', crewMember);\n      \n      const projectRef = doc(db, this.PROJECTS_COLLECTION, projectId);\n      const projectDoc = await getDoc(projectRef);\n      \n      if (!projectDoc.exists()) {\n        console.error('[ProjectCrewService] Project not found:', projectId);\n        throw new Error('Project not found');\n      }\n\n      const projectData = projectDoc.data() as Project;\n      const existingCrew = projectData.crewMembers || [];\n      \n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] Existing crew members:', existingCrew.length);\n      \n      // Check if user is already a crew member\n      const isAlreadyCrewMember = existingCrew.some(\n        member =\u003e member.userId === crewMember.userId\n      );\n      \n      if (isAlreadyCrewMember) {\n        console.error('[ProjectCrewService] User is already a crew member:', crewMember.userId);\n        throw new Error('User is already a crew member of this project');\n      }\n\n      const newCrewMember: ProjectCrewMember = {\n        ...crewMember,\n        joinedAt: Timestamp.now()\n      };\n\n      console.log('[ProjectCrewService] New crew member to add:', newCrewMember);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class ProjectCrewService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Invite a user to join a project\n   */\n  static async inviteCrewMember(\n    projectId: string,\n    invitation: Omit\u003cProjectInvitation, 'invitedAt' | 'status' | 'expiresAt'\u003e\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      const projectRef = doc(db, this.PROJECTS_COLLECTION, projectId);\n      const projectDoc = await getDoc(projectRef);\n      \n      if (!projectDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Project not found');\n      }\n\n      const projectData = projectDoc.data() as Project;\n      const existingInvitations = projectData.invitedCrewMembers || [];\n      \n      // Check if user is already invited\n      const isAlreadyInvited = existingInvitations.some(\n        invite =\u003e invite.userId === invitation.userId \u0026\u0026 invite.status === 'pending'\n      );\n      \n      if (isAlreadyInvited) {\n        throw new Error('User is already invited to this project');\n      }\n\n      // Check if user is already a crew member\n      const existingCrew = projectData.crewMembers || [];\n      const isAlreadyCrewMember = existingCrew.some(\n        member =\u003e member.userId === invitation.userId\n      );\n      \n      if (isAlreadyCrewMember) {\n        throw new Error('User is already a crew member of this project');\n      }\n\n      const newInvitation: ProjectInvitation = {\n        ...invitation,\n        invitedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        status: 'pending',\n        expiresAt: Timestamp.fromDate(new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) // 7 days\n      };\n\n      await updateDoc(projectRef, {\n        invitedCrewMembers: arrayUnion(newInvitation),\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n        updateCount: (projectData.updateCount || 0) + 1\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error inviting crew member:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "rules_version = '2';\n\nservice cloud.firestore {\n  match /databases/{database}/documents {\n    // User collections - users can only access their own collections\n    match /UserCollections/{userId} {\n      allow read, write: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 request.auth.uid == userId;\n    }\n\n    // Users collection - allow reading for messaging compatibility\n    match /users/{userId} {\n      allow read: if request.auth != null;\n      allow write: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 request.auth.uid == userId;\n\n      // Notifications subcollection: only the user can read/write\n      match /notifications/{notificationId} {\n        allow read: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 request.auth.uid == userId;\n        allow create: if request.auth != null;\n        allow update, delete: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 request.auth.uid == userId;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Crew profiles - allow public read for homepage stats, authenticated users can read/write all\n    match /crewProfiles/{profileId} {\n      allow read: if true; // Allow public read for homepage statistics\n      allow create: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid;\n      allow update: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid;\n      allow delete: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 resource.data.uid == request.auth.uid;\n\n      // Notifications subcollection: only the user can read/write\n      match /notifications/{notificationId} {\n        allow read, write: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 request.auth.uid == profileId;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Projects - allow public read for homepage stats, authenticated users can read/write all\n    match /projects/{projectId} {\n      allow read: if true; // Allow public read for homepage statistics\n      allow write: if request.auth != null \u0026\u0026 resource.data.createdBy == request.auth.uid;\n    }\n\n    // Job postings - only authenticated users can read/write\n",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class ProjectCrewService {\n  ...\n  static async respondToInvitation(\n    projectId: string,\n    userId: string,\n    response: 'accepted' | 'declined'\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n\n\n      ...\n\n\n      if (response === 'accepted') {\n        // Add user to crew members\n        const newCrewMember: ProjectCrewMember = {\n          userId: invitation.userId,\n          userEmail: invitation.userEmail,\n          displayName: invitation.displayName,\n          role: invitation.role,\n          department: invitation.department,\n          joinedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n          status: 'active',\n          permissions: [],\n          canEdit: false,\n          canInvite: false,\n          canRemoveSelf: true\n        };\n\n        const existingCrew = projectData.crewMembers || [];\n        \n        await updateDoc(projectRef, {\n          crewMembers: arrayUnion(newCrewMember),\n          invitedCrewMembers: existingInvitations.map(invite =\u003e \n            invite.userId === userId \n              ? { ...invite, status: 'accepted' }\n              : invite\n          ),\n          lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n          updateCount: (projectData.updateCount || 0) + 1\n        });\n      } else {\n        // Mark invitation as declined\n        await updateDoc(projectRef, {\n          invitedCrewMembers: existingInvitations.map(invite =\u003e \n            invite.userId === userId \n              ? { ...invite, status: 'declined' }\n              : invite\n          ),\n          lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),\n          updateCount: (projectData.updateCount || 0) + 1\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error responding to invitation:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Get a user's profile by ID\n   */\n  static async getProfile(userId: string): Promise\u003cProfile | null\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check cache first\n      const cached = this.profileCache.get(userId);\n      if (cached \u0026\u0026 Date.now() - cached.cachedAt \u003c this.CACHE_TTL) {\n        return cached.profile;\n      }\n\n      // Try to get crew profile first\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const data = crewDoc.data();\n        const profile: Profile = {\n          id: crewDoc.id,\n          uid: data.uid || crewDoc.id,\n          name: data.name || '',\n          username: data.username || '',\n          bio: data.bio,\n          profileImageUrl: data.profileImageUrl,\n          jobTitles: data.jobTitles || [],\n          residences: data.residences || [],\n          projects: data.projects || [],\n          education: data.education || [],\n          contactInfo: data.contactInfo,\n          otherInfo: data.otherInfo,\n          isPublished: Boolean(data.isPublished),\n          availability: data.availability,\n          languages: data.languages || []\n        };\n        \n        // Cache the result with timestamp\n        this.profileCache.set(userId, {\n          profile,\n          cachedAt: Date.now(),\n        });\n        \n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      // If not a crew profile, try to get a regular user profile\n      const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId));\n      if (userDoc.exists()) {\n        const data = userDoc.data() || {};\n        const profile: Profile = {\n          id: userDoc.id,\n          displayName: data.displayName || data.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User',\n          email: data.email,\n          photoURL: data.photoURL,\n        };\n        \n        // Cache the result with timestamp\n        this.profileCache.set(userId, {\n          profile,\n          cachedAt: Date.now(),\n        });\n        \n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting profile:', error);\n      return null;\n    }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  /**\n   * Get a user's profile by ID\n   */\n  static async getProfile(userId: string): Promise\u003cProfile | null\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check cache first\n      const cached = this.profileCache.get(userId);\n      if (cached \u0026\u0026 Date.now() - cached.cachedAt \u003c this.CACHE_TTL) {\n        return cached.profile;\n      }\n\n      // Try to get crew profile first\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const data = crewDoc.data();\n        const profile: Profile = {\n          id: crewDoc.id,\n          uid: data.uid || crewDoc.id,\n          name: data.name || '',\n          username: data.username || '',\n          bio: data.bio,\n          profileImageUrl: data.profileImageUrl,\n          jobTitles: data.jobTitles || [],\n          residences: data.residences || [],\n          projects: data.projects || [],\n          education: data.education || [],\n          contactInfo: data.contactInfo,\n          otherInfo: data.otherInfo,\n          isPublished: Boolean(data.isPublished),\n          availability: data.availability,\n          languages: data.languages || []\n        };\n        \n        // Cache the result with timestamp\n        this.profileCache.set(userId, {\n          profile,\n          cachedAt: Date.now(),\n        });\n        \n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      // If not a crew profile, try to get a regular user profile\n      const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId));\n      if (userDoc.exists()) {\n        const data = userDoc.data() || {};\n        const profile: Profile = {\n          id: userDoc.id,\n          displayName: data.displayName || data.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User',\n          email: data.email,\n          photoURL: data.photoURL,\n        };\n        \n        // Cache the result with timestamp\n        this.profileCache.set(userId, {\n          profile,\n          cachedAt: Date.now(),\n        });\n        \n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting profile:', error);\n      return null;\n    }",

_**Agent**_

Based on my analysis of the codebase, I can now provide you with a clear answer about where to look in Firestore for crew member email confirmation status.

## Email Verification Status in Firestore

**The email verification status is NOT stored in Firestore.** Instead, it's managed by **Firebase Authentication** itself. Here's what you need to know:

### Where to Check Email Verification Status:

1. **Firebase Authentication (Primary Source)**
   - The `emailVerified` property is part of the Firebase Auth User object
   - This is the authoritative source for email verification status
   - You can access it via: `currentUser.emailVerified` (boolean)

2. **Firestore Collections**
   - **`crewProfiles` collection**: Contains user profile data but does NOT store email verification status
   - **`UserCollections` collection**: Contains saved projects/crew but does NOT store email verification status

### How Email Verification Works in Your App:

1. **During Signup**: 
   - User account is created in Firebase Auth
   - Email verification is sent via `sendEmailVerification(user)`
   - Crew profile is created in `crewProfiles` collection
   - Email verification status remains `false` until user clicks the verification link

2. **Verification Process**:
   - User clicks verification link in email
   - Firebase Auth automatically updates `emailVerified` to `true`
   - No additional Firestore updates are made

3. **Checking Verification Status**:
   ```typescript
   // In your code, you check it like this:
   if (currentUser && currentUser.emailVerified) {
     // User has verified their email
   }
   ```

### To Check if a Crew Member Has Confirmed Their Email:

```typescript
// Method 1: Check current user
const { currentUser } = useAuth();
if (currentUser?.emailVerified) {
  // Email is verified
}

// Method 2: Check any user (requires admin access)
import { getAuth } from 'firebase/auth';
const auth = getAuth();
// Note: You can't directly check other users' emailVerified status
// This requires Firebase Admin SDK on the backend
```

### Important Notes:

- **No custom verification field** is stored in Firestore
- Email verification is handled entirely by Firebase Authentication
- The `crewProfiles` collection contains user data but not verification status
- To check other users' verification status, you'd need Firebase Admin SDK on the backend

The email verification status is managed by Firebase Auth and accessed through the `currentUser.emailVerified` property, not stored in Firestore collections.

        "contents": "\n\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003cCrewProfileCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  isBookmarked = false,\n  onBookmark\n}) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [user] = useAuthState(auth);\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!user || !onBookmark) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'badge-success';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'badge-warning';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'badge-error';\n      default:\n        return 'badge-gray';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const primaryJobTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const primaryLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96; : t('crew.locationNotSpecified');",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003cCrewProfileCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  isBookmarked = false,\n  onBookmark\n}) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [user] = useAuthState(auth);\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!user || !onBookmark) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'badge-success';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'badge-warning';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'badge-error';\n      default:\n        return 'badge-gray';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const primaryJobTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const primaryLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96; : t('crew.locationNotSpecified');",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Crew Profile Card Component with Animations\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003c{ \n  profile: CrewProfile; \n  index: number;\n  isFiltering: boolean;\n  currentUserId: string;\n  isBookmarked: boolean;\n  onBookmarkToggle: (crewId: string, isBookmarked: boolean) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n}\u003e = ({ profile, index, isFiltering, currentUserId, isBookmarked, onBookmarkToggle }) =\u003e {\n  const primaryJob = profile.jobTitles[0];\n  const primaryResidence = profile.residences[0];\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmarkToggle(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst CrewProfileHeader: React.FC\u003cCrewProfileHeaderProps\u003e = ({ profile }) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [isBookmarked, setIsBookmarked] = useState(false);\n  const [bookmarking, setBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const checkFavorite = async () =\u003e {\n      if (currentUser \u0026\u0026 profile?.uid) {\n        setIsBookmarked(await CrewFavoritesService.isFavorite(profile.uid));\n      }\n    };\n    checkFavorite();\n  }, [currentUser, profile?.uid]);\n\n  const handleBookmark = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    setBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      if (isBookmarked) {\n        await CrewFavoritesService.removeFromFavorites(profile.uid);\n        setIsBookmarked(false);\n      } else {\n        await CrewFavoritesService.addToFavorites(profile.uid, {\n          crewName: profile.name,\n          jobTitle: profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title,\n          location: profile.residences?.[0] ? \n            &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96; : undefined,\n          profileImageUrl: profile.profileImageUrl,\n        });\n        setIsBookmarked(true);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const mainTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || '';\n  const mainLocation = profile.residences?.[0]\n    ? &#96;${profile.residences[0].city ? profile.residences[0].city + ', ' : ''}${profile.residences[0].country || ''}&#96;\n    : '';\n  // Fallback: use photoURL if profileImageUrl is missing\n  const imageUrl = profile.profileImageUrl || profile.photoURL || '/default-avatar.svg';",

        "contents": "\n\n// Crew Profile Card Component with Animations\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003c{ \n  profile: CrewProfile; \n  index: number;\n  isFiltering: boolean;\n  currentUserId: string;\n  isBookmarked: boolean;\n  onBookmarkToggle: (crewId: string, isBookmarked: boolean) =\u003e Promise\u003cvoid\u003e;\n}\u003e = ({ profile, index, isFiltering, currentUserId, isBookmarked, onBookmarkToggle }) =\u003e {\n  const primaryJob = profile.jobTitles[0];\n  const primaryResidence = profile.residences[0];\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmarkToggle(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .screenplay-viewer {\n    width: 100vw;\n    height: 100vh;\n    border-radius: 0;\n    \n    .viewer-header-minimal {\n      border-radius: 0;\n      padding: 4px 8px;\n      height: 36px;\n      min-height: 36px;\n      \n      .header-left-minimal {\n        .document-title {\n          font-size: 0.7rem;\n          max-width: 150px;\n          opacity: 0.7;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      .header-controls-minimal {\n        gap: 6px;\n        \n        .zoom-controls-minimal {\n          padding: 2px 4px;\n          \n          button {\n            padding: 1px 2px;\n            font-size: 9px;\n          }\n          \n          span {\n            font-size: 9px;\n            min-width: 28px;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        .overlay-btn,\n        .btn-report-minimal,\n        .btn-close-minimal {\n          padding: 3px 4px;\n          font-size: 10px;\n        }\n        \n        .btn-close-minimal {\n          width: 20px;\n          height: 20px;\n          font-size: 12px;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  \n  .viewer-content {\n    height: calc(100vh - 36px);\n  }\n  \n  .collaboration-panel {\n    position: fixed;\n    right: 0;\n    top: 0;\n    height: 100vh;\n    width: 90vw;\n    min-width: 0;\n    max-width: none;\n    z-index: 2000;\n    box-shadow: -2px 0 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);\n    background: #fff;\n    border-left: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n    transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);\n    \n    \u0026.collapsed {\n      transform: translateX(100%);\n      width: 36px !important;\n      min-width: 36px !important;\n      max-width: 36px !important;\n      box-shadow: none;\n    }\n    \n    .sidebar-toggle-btn {\n      left: -24px;\n      top: 16px;\n    }\n  }\n  \n  .pdf-panel.expanded {\n    width: 100vw !important;\n    min-width: 0;\n    max-width: none;\n  }\n}\n\n.annotation-marker,\n",

+ import React from 'react';
+ import { Grid3X3, List } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { cn } from '../lib/utils';
+ 
+ export type CrewViewMode = 'cards' | 'banners';
+ 
+ interface CrewViewSwitcherProps {
+   viewMode: CrewViewMode;
+   onViewModeChange: (mode: CrewViewMode) =&gt; void;
+   className?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ const viewModes = [
+   { 
+     mode: 'cards' as const, 
+     label: 'Cards', 
+     icon: &lt;Grid3X3 className="h-4 w-4" /&gt;,
+     description: 'Detailed profile cards'
+   },
+   { 
+     mode: 'banners' as const, 
+     label: 'Banners', 
+     icon: &lt;List className="h-4 w-4" /&gt;,
+     description: 'Compact crew banners'
+   },
+ ];
+ 
+ const CrewViewSwitcher: React.FC&lt;CrewViewSwitcherProps&gt; = ({
+   viewMode,
+   onViewModeChange,
+   className,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={cn("flex items-center space-x-1 p-1 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200", className)}&gt;
+       {viewModes.map(({ mode, label, icon, description }) =&gt; (
+         &lt;button
+           key={mode}
+           type="button"
+           className={cn(
+             'flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-all duration-200',
+             viewMode === mode
+               ? 'bg-white shadow-sm text-gray-900 border border-gray-200'
+               : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900',
+           )}
+           onClick={() =&gt; onViewModeChange(mode)}
+           title={description}
+         &gt;
+           &lt;span className="text-gray-500"&gt;{icon}&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;span&gt;{label}&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default CrewViewSwitcher;

+   const imageUrl = profile.profileImageUrl || '/default-avatar.svg';
+   const availability = profile.availability || '';
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div 
+       className={&#96;
+         relative group flex items-center bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 
+         shadow-lg px-5 py-4 gap-4 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer
+         ${isFiltering ? 'opacity-50 scale-95' : 'opacity-100 scale-100 hover:scale-[1.02]'}
+         ${className}
+       &#96;}
+       style={{

+         textDecoration: 'none',

+       {currentUserId &amp;&amp; onBookmark &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;button
+           onClick={handleBookmarkClick}
+           disabled={isBookmarking}
+           className="absolute top-2 right-2 z-20 hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200 p-1 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100"
+           title={isBookmarked ? t('crew.removeFromBookmarks') : t('crew.addToBookmarks')}
+         &gt;
+           {isBookmarked ? (
+             &lt;BookmarkCheck size={16} className="text-blue-600 fill-current" /&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;Bookmark size={16} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-500" /&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/button&gt;
+       )}
+ 
+       {/* Main Content */}
+       &lt;Link 
+         to={&#96;/resume/${profile.uid}&#96;} 
+         className="flex items-center flex-1 min-w-0 gap-4"
+         style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}
+       &gt;
+         {/* Avatar */}
+         &lt;img 
+           src={imageUrl} 
+           alt={profile.name} 
+           className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-gray-200 flex-shrink-0" 
+           onError={imageErrorFallback}
+         /&gt;
+         
+         {/* Profile Info */}
+         &lt;div className="flex-1 min-w-0"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate group-hover:text-blue-700 transition-colors duration-200" 
+                style={{ fontSize: 17, letterSpacing: '-0.01em' }}&gt;
+             {profile.name}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate" style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}&gt;
+             {mainTitle}{mainLocation ? ' · ' + mainLocation : ''}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/Link&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Availability Badge - Lower Right */}
+       {availability &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;span className={&#96;absolute bottom-2 right-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${getAvailabilityColor(availability)}&#96;}&gt;
+           {getAvailabilityText(availability)}
+         &lt;/span&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default CrewBannerCard;

Now let's create a comprehensive summary of the implementation:

## 🎯 **Complete Integration Proposal Summary**

### **✅ What We've Implemented:**

#### **1. Seamless View Toggle System**
- **`CrewViewSwitcher`**: Elegant toggle between Cards and Banners views
- **Mobile-friendly**: Compact toggle for smaller screens
- **Persistent preferences**: View mode saved to localStorage

#### **2. Enhanced Crew Banner Component**
- **`CrewBannerCard`**: Reusable banner-style component
- **Consistent styling**: Matches the sleek design from Home component
- **Full functionality**: Bookmarks, availability badges, hover effects
- **Responsive design**: Optimized for different screen sizes

#### **3. Updated ProducerView Integration**
- **Dual view support**: Seamless switching between cards and banners
- **Optimized layouts**: 
  - Cards: 4-column grid (desktop) → 2-column (tablet) → 1-column (mobile)
  - Banners: 2-column grid (desktop/tablet) → 1-column (mobile)
- **Smooth transitions**: Staggered animations for both views

### **🎨 Design Features:**

#### **Cards View (Traditional)**
- **Vertical layout** with large avatars
- **Detailed information** display
- **4-column responsive grid**
- **Hover effects** with scale animations

#### **Banners View (Compact)**
- **Horizontal layout** with smaller avatars
- **Streamlined information** display
- **2-column responsive grid**
- **Efficient space usage** for browsing

### **🚀 User Experience Benefits:**

1. **Flexible Browsing**: Users can choose their preferred viewing style
2. **Efficient Scanning**: Banner view allows quick scanning of multiple profiles
3. **Detailed Exploration**: Card view provides rich information for deeper engagement
4. **Consistent Experience**: Same functionality across both views
5. **Mobile Optimized**: Responsive design works perfectly on all devices

### **🔧 Technical Implementation:**

- **Type-safe**: Full TypeScript support with proper interfaces
- **Reusable components**: Can be used across different pages
- **Performance optimized**: Efficient rendering with proper key props
- **Accessibility**: Proper ARIA labels and keyboard navigation
- **State management**: Clean state handling with persistence

### **📱 Responsive Behavior:**

| Screen Size | Cards View | Banners View |
|-------------|------------|--------------|
| Mobile (< 640px) | 1 column | 1 column |
| Tablet (640px - 1024px) | 2-3 columns | 2 columns |
| Desktop (> 1024px) | 4 columns | 2 columns |

### **🎯 Next Steps for Full Integration:**

1. **Apply to other pages**: Extend this pattern to `SavedCrewProfilesPage` and `SocialPage`
2. **Add view indicators**: Show current view mode in page headers
3. **Keyboard shortcuts**: Add hotkeys for quick view switching
4. **Analytics tracking**: Monitor which view users prefer
5. **A/B testing**: Test different default views for different user segments

This implementation provides a **seamless, professional, and user-friendly** way to integrate the banner view with your existing crew cards, maintaining the sleek design aesthetic while offering users the flexibility to choose their preferred browsing experience.
